svg.title: Map of the places Lester and Winnie Bradford lived and worked
svg.desc: From Oklahoma, Nebraska, Kentucky, Maine, Montana, Oregon and Connecticut to London and Sierra Leone (Freetown, Rotifunk, Kayima, Manjama); then Louisiana and Washington State; then Juba, Khartoum and El Obeid in Sudan and Tarbela in Pakistan; and volunteer work in Ukraine, Russia, Mauritania, Zimbabwe, South Africa, Bolivia, Brazil, Haiti, the Philippines and Indonesia.
